name: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc.
summary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in wireless communication, microdevice, automobile brakes, mechatronics, chemicals, textiles, and real estate businesses in China and internationally. It offers disaster prevention, monitoring, video, automotive radar, and broadcasting systems; wireless communication equipment for ships; communication and sensor equipment for transportation infrastructure; bridge system for merchant shipping; close-proximity wireless solutions; ultrasonic-related devices; and equipment for the ministry of defense.
